concept.feedback: The concept meets all listed gates. The local checksum definition is treated as the complete target condition, with no unnecessary external job-title requirement.

findings.detail: The premise centers on an emergency watch change, overlapping incoming and off-going personnel, signed handover records, and local handover procedure.
The proposal supplies its setting, participants, evidence sources, six status dimensions, and locally defined checksum success condition without requiring an external role definition.
A whiteout, equipment fault, delayed alarm, and constrained vessel passages provide a coherent operational reason for a difficult handover review.
No participant is named as favored, and the text explicitly avoids seniority, first-speaker, fault-noticer, name, and genre shortcuts.
It expressly requires relational, temporal, causal, spatial, sequence, and protocol statuses, with corresponding operational trace types.
This is an incident-reconciliation and watch-handover scenario on a research vessel, not a sealed-space crime or conventional locked-room setup.
findings.gate: low resemblance to a stock locked-room mystery

final.feedback: Accept. The item is self-contained and its narrative evidence supports the requested calculations without directly disclosing the qualifying candidate.

findings.detail: The story supplies the status scale, all six evidence values for each candidate, the tally procedure, the accepted tally, and the final qualification rule.
The maritime emergency framing is coherent, and the evidence is organized into readable narrative packets despite the deliberately distributed clues.
Answering the main and counterfactual questions requires assembling six statuses for a person and applying the stated multi-pass iterative procedure; the answer is not obtainable from a single clue.
The reader-facing story does not identify any named candidate as satisfying the accepted tally or otherwise reveal the concordant watchkeeper.
The main, intermediate, counterfactual, and scalar questions specify the requested answer forms clearly.

story.feedback: deterministic, grounding, and model story critics accept
